recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的嗜中性球體積偏大、細胞核分成約 6–7 葉（hypersegmented neutrophil，≥6 葉即具診斷意義），背景紅血球有卵圓形巨紅血球與淚滴細胞，兩者合併就是惡性貧血等巨母細胞性貧血的血片特徵。
features: Enlarged neutrophil (arrow) with a hypersegmented nucleus of approximately six to seven lobes
Normal fine neutrophilic granules in the cytoplasm
Background red cells with anisopoikilocytosis including oval macrocytes, elongated forms, and teardrop cells
Single small platelet; no polychromasia evident
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an enlarged neutrophil (arrow) with a hypersegmented nucleus containing approximately six to seven lobes. The background red cells show anisopoikilocytosis with oval macrocytes, elongated cells, teardrop forms, and small fragments, without evident polychromasia. No blasts are seen. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic anemia, such as pernicious anemia due to vitamin B12 deficiency.

ddx.vs: The hereditary form is a benign autosomal dominant trait with normal red cells and normal B12/folate, unlike the macro-ovalocytes and poikilocytes present here.

ddx.dx: Iron deficiency or uremia with hypersegmentation
ddx.vs: These can cause mild hypersegmentation but have microcytic or normocytic red cells rather than macro-ovalocytes.
Drug-induced hypersegmentation and macrocytosis are morphologically similar, so distinction depends on medication history and vitamin levels.
